Project: P07 — AI Software Project Delivery Orchestrator
Summary: Planning agent and dependency graph
Description: Implement planning agent: LLM produces task list with estimates and dependencies. Validate output: check for DAG (no cycles) using topological sort. If cycles found, retry once with feedback. Store task graph. Human approval required.
Business Value: Task planning with dependency validation is a hard technical requirement — circular dependencies break delivery.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Planner produces 10–20 tasks with dependencies. 2. DAG validation runs on output. 3. Cycle detected → retry with feedback. 4. Valid DAG stored in tasks + task_dependencies. 5. Unit test: cycle detection with known cyclic input.
Technical Notes: DAG validation: topological sort (Kahn's algorithm). If cycle detected: add cycle description to LLM retry prompt. See .kiro/specs/project-07/spec.md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: DAG cycle detection. Integration: planning phase → valid task graph.
Security Requirements: No project content in logs.
Definition of Done: Planning agent tested. DAG cycle detection tested. Human reviewer approved.
